old.text: The corporation's property tax page states that payment can be made through handheld machines of bill collectors integrated with a central server, at 72 Mee-Seva centres within corporation limits, at citizen service centres in all 30 circles and the corporation head office, and online or by NEFT and RTGS, and at 537 branches of 8 banks.
old.notes: A usable rule about where the tax may be paid, with counts for each channel.

corrections.reason: Section 1 requires one claim to assert one checkable thing and section 8's lint item 1 flags list claims. This record bundles five payment channels and four independently falsifiable counts (72, 30, 537, 8) into a single verified assertion, so the status cannot be attributed to any one channel. No waiver is visible in the audit's permitted inputs. Section 13 authorises the auditor to split compound claims; the record is deleted and replaced by four atomic claims plus the amended claim_hyderabad_ptax_thirty_circles, all resting on the same observed page text and the same source.

support.auditNote: Split, not new evidence: each replacement record carries one channel from the deleted record's own wording, at the same grade, basis and status. The citizen-service-centre channel is carried by the existing claim_hyderabad_ptax_thirty_circles rather than a fifth new record, which also removes the same-source duplication between the two.

Section 1 tells the integrator to reuse a published ID and change content rather than identity, and section 13 lets the auditor merge duplicates, so the payment-channel assertion is carried here instead of in a fifth new record. The amended wording preserves the 30-circle structure that the owner cell relies on and adds no fact absent from the deleted record.

corrections.reason: Section 8 sets mentioned where the topic is named but no actionable value is given, and absent where the reviewed evidence does not touch the topic. The only claim cited records a portal form asking for a property tax identification number or a registered mobile number. An identifier is a data field, not a document, and no reviewed route for this scenario refers to a document at all, so the topic is not named. The document lists the corporation publishes belong to new assessment and mutation, which the scenario summary excludes.

support.auditNote: The cell's own note already concedes that what the route asks for is an identifier rather than a document to submit, provide, upload, produce or attach. The limitation is carried by claim_hyderabad_ptax_documents_for_payment_unknown, an Unknown claim, which under section 8 records a limitation and cannot supply a positive cell value.

corrections.reason: Section 9 allows an absent cell only optional topic-only claimIds. claim_hyderabad_ptax_ptin_or_mobile_required does not touch the documents topic, so citing it would present an identifier field as document evidence.
